correctness.rationale: Normality follows from the odd-cycle condition; the Ohsugi--Hibi facet classification yields 10 coordinate and 15 independent-set inequalities. Danilov--Stanley identifies interior exponents. Standard graded local duality and Cohen--Macaulayness bound canonical generator degrees by 10. The included independent standard-library verifier exactly enumerates every integral exponent composition in degrees 5 through 10 and its edge-removability, obtaining minimal counts (1,0,10,0,0,0). Degree-seven supports are exactly the ten closed neighborhoods. All claims hold over arbitrary fields; the S5 character decomposition is restricted to characteristic zero.

value.rationale: The homogeneous dualizing module of a prominent projectively normal nine-dimensional toric variety is given as an explicit symmetric eleven-monomial ideal rather than only by abstract CM-type data. The ten degree-seven monomial supports determine the first equivariant canonical generator space and provide concrete input for graded and equivariant syzygy computations. Since the known Hilbert polynomial already implies type eleven, the claimed new value is specifically the constructive full ideal and S5 orbit, not a table recomputation. This is a complete intrinsic structural invariant of the geometric edge algebra.
